selection: Fixed before broader model runs: local-input tasks <=20MB with text/table/sequence outputs supported by the CPU image and metered text-only grader. a-1-1 is the previously declared pipeline smoke. This is a feasibility-stratified subset, not representative sampling.

tasks.question: I have a forward sequence, can you help me convert it to reverse complementary sequence? The sequence is: AATTGGGACCAACACTAGAATATCACCCTCCCTCTGGTCCTGAGGGAGAGGAATCCTCCTGGGTTTCCAGATCCTG
Calculate the average coverage only over positions with non-zero coverage directly from the BAM file. Do not use any external BED file. Just use the aligned regions as captured bases.

Design CRISPR gRNAs for human FOXP3 using 20nt guide sequences with NGG PAM. Search both forward and reverse strands. Apply basic quality filters: GC content 20-80%, exclude sequences with four or more consecutive identical nucleotides (e.g., TTTT).

Compute Pearson correlations between all gene-methylation site pairs (all-vs-all) using DNA methylation beta values and gene expression values from the same samples. Apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction globally across all pairs. Identify gene-methylation site pairs with significant negative correlations (FDR < 0.05).
Perform trimming of 16s FASTQ reads based on the provided primer sequences.
Calculate the isoelectric point (pI) of each protein in the given FASTA file.

Annotate LC-MS peaks by matching each query m/z against the provided HMDB database using a mass tolerance of +/-0.01 Da, and report up to 3 candidate metabolites per peak ranked by absolute ppm error.
Calculate the mean, median, standard deviation, and interquartile range (IQR) for all numeric columns in the provided dataset. Return the results in a tidy table.
Identify significantly differentially expressed genes between treated and control groups using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test. Apply Benjamini-Hochberg correction and return genes with FDR < 0.05.
Apply PCA to a gene expression dataset. Z-score standardize the features before applying PCA. Compute the proportion of variance explained by the first 10 principal components.

excluded: Other234tasks not in overnight pilot. Network-required, image-output, large-input and specialized dependency tasks deferred; no benchmark removed from full244 declaration.
